digest: 13 spec items (S1–S7, C1–C2, T1–T3, Q1) checked against src/ and found no test files; 6 candidate findings: S3 pollMs default/clamp, S6 message-prefix match, C1 extra cancellation markers, T1 direct-dynamic degradation, T3 launchRetries name, Q1 missing tests.

candidateFindings.title: Stop poll default and minimum deviate from S3
candidateFindings.claim: The default pollMs is 200ms instead of 50ms, and the floor is 1ms instead of 10ms.
specEvidence: SPEC.md S3: pollMs default 50ms; caller values below 10ms must not be used
testEvidence: No test files exist to exercise the default or clamp.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Observable effect is only polling latency; the spec default is explicit, so this is a deviation.

candidateFindings.title: isWorkflowStopRequestedError accepts messages by prefix
candidateFindings.claim: The predicate returns true for any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested', which S6 forbids.
specEvidence: SPEC.md S6: only an error named WorkflowStopRequested is a stop error; message content must not be used
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Low; the spec wording is direct. Callers that rely on the prefix could be affected.

candidateFindings.title: Returned-cancellation predicate promotes extra markers
candidateFindings.claim: The predicate treats 'cancelled' and 'timeout' strings and cancelled===true booleans as cancellation, but C1 allows exactly aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR.
specEvidence: SPEC.md C1: exactly aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR; other provider errors must not be promoted
testEvidence: No test covers other provider errors not being promoted.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Commit 654f639 message indicates related cancel/timeout handling was intentional; whether the spec or the code is authoritative needs confirmation.

candidateFindings.title: Direct-dynamic completed runs can lose completed_degraded
candidateFindings.claim: For direct-dynamic terminal runs, the dynamic branch overwrites the semantic status, so a completed run with degradation is not reported as completed_degraded unless the controller-status branch yields it.
specEvidence: SPEC.md T1: completed run with degradation record has semantic state completed_degraded
implementationEvidence: src/workflow-terminal.ts:67-68 degradation mapping only in nonDynamicSemanticStatus
src/workflow-terminal.ts:80-95 direct-dynamic branch reassigns semanticStatus; else falls to completed_without_semantic_result
testEvidence: No test files exist for terminal summaries.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Depends on whether direct-dynamic runs with degradation are in T1 scope; spec wording is unconditional.

candidateFindings.title: Launch retry total exported under a different field name
candidateFindings.claim: The summary exports launchRetries, not launchRetryAttempts; the spec says both names are a public contract that must not change.
specEvidence: SPEC.md T3: outputRetryAttempts and launchRetryAttempts are sums across tasks; field names are a public contract
testEvidence: No test checks exported field names.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Commit 654f639 message mentions a shorter retry field name, so the rename looks intentional and conflicts with the spec. Confirm which is authoritative.

candidateFindings.title: No unit tests exist for any requirement
candidateFindings.claim: Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item; the repo has no test files and no test script.
specEvidence: SPEC.md Q1: each S, C, T item has a unit test confirming it
testEvidence: Glob found no *.test.* or *.spec.* files; inspect-tests reports no test files outside .agent-workflow.
candidateFindings.uncertainty: Tests may live outside the repo or be planned; the absence is confirmed only within this checkout.

noIssueNotes: REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-007, REQ-009, REQ-011 have positive implementation evidence in src/ but no test evidence; their coverage is implementation-only.
T2 (REQ-011) holds only for terminal direct-dynamic runs without incomplete/synthesized/exhausted/blocked/stopped controller status, as the code is written.
C2 (REQ-009): JSON.parse nesting shrinks each recursion step; the parsed!==value guard is effectively unreachable but does not cause unbounded recursion.

scopeLimitations.text: Tests were inspected but not executed by this read-only stage.
No test files exist in the checkout, so all test-evidence claims are absence-based.
Coverage uses map-implementation artifacts plus direct reads of src/workflow-stop.ts, src/workflow-cancellation.ts, src/workflow-terminal.ts; other src files were not reviewed.
